title: Placed Consumer Accounts Risk Table: Debit-Card Rolling Limit After Returned Payments
content:
Payments risk table for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. It fixes the rolling limit of the debit-card ceiling of the day, that is, the card-payment amount the debit-card ceiling starts from, according to the returned payments on the account.

## Table

| Returned payments received on the account in the last six months | Rolling limit of the debit-card ceiling |
|---|---|
| Two or more | $1200.00 |
| Exactly one | $2400.00 |
| None | The stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum |

**Clause.** The debit-card ceiling's rolling limit is $1200.00 for an account with two or more returned payments received in the last six months, $2400.00 for an account with exactly one returned payment received in the last six months, and the stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum for an account with no returned payment received in the last six months.

## Counting the returns

- Every returned-payment entry on the account's money history counts, whatever the channel or the reason of the return, by the date the return was received.
- A return is received in the last six months when fewer than six whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month.

| Handling date 2026-10-10: date the return was received | In the last six months |
|---|---|
| 2026-04-11 | Yes |
| 2026-04-10 | No (six whole months) |

## Hypothetical readings

*Invented money histories, handling date 2026-10-10.*

| Returns received | Count in the window | Rolling limit |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-02 and 2026-08-17 | 2 | $1200.00 |
| 2026-08-17 only | 1 | $2400.00 |
| 2026-04-10 only | 0 | The stage's rolling 30-day card-payment maximum |
| 2026-03-01, 2026-04-10 and 2026-09-30 | 1 | $2400.00 |

The figures $1200.00 and $2400.00 apply at every stage; only the no-return row depends on the stage.
